chapterPurpose: ‘Clothes — How Things are Made’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects fibres and yarn, weaving and fabric, warp and weft, handloom traditions, baya weaverbird as a natural weaver. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
